Subtotal/Payment lines agree on 102.00 but are not consulted."},{"receipt":"077.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"23.26","issue":"Current rule picks tier-4 last candidate (TOTAL: 23.25). Pre-rounding 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' is used, but the final TOTAL after rounding adjustment is 23.25. The 'take last tier-N candidate' choice is unstable across receipts (helps 077, hurts 074)."},{"receipt":"078.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":null,"issue":"Keyword line 'Grand Total' has no number on same line; two-line fallback appears not to reach the next line that contains the amount (92.80), or the amount is on a further line beyond the current 1-line lookahead window."},{"receipt":"034.jpg","field":"date","predicted":"2018-08-09","issue":"Ambiguous DD/MM vs MM/DD interpretation of '09/03/2018' vs '09/08/2018' across OCR variants; code accepts whichever variant parses first without checking plausibility or cross-OCR agreement."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"RC1","summary":"Total selection heuristic 'last candidate in tier wins' is brittle","detail":"Within a single priority tier, the current logic blindly reverses the candidate list. On receipts with a noisy trailing 'Total Amt Rounded' or post-total artifacts, this picks OCR-corrupted numbers. On other receipts the last candidate is correct. No consensus/cross-check is used."},{"id":"RC2","summary":"Two-line fallback window too narrow and not keyword-anchored","detail":"When the keyword line has no number (e.g., 'Grand Total' alone), the fallback only inspects the next 1–2 non-empty lines and breaks on the first number-less line, missing cases where the amount sits further down (table-separated layouts)."},{"id":"RC3","summary":"No cross-OCR agreement / plausibility voting","detail":"The pipeline runs two OCR variants but only takes the first non-null result per field. It does not vote across variants, does not prefer values that also appear as Subtotal/Payment, and does not sanity-check (e.g., totals ≥ subtotals, dates with month ≤ 12 preferred)."},{"id":"RC4","summary":"Date disambiguation is first-match-wins","detail":"DATE_PATTERNS are tried in order and the first parse is accepted even when another OCR variant yields a different plausible date. No preference for dates where both day≤31 and month≤12 unambiguously, nor cross-OCR agreement."},{"id":"RC5","summary":"Skill docs do not codify the hard-won extraction rules","detail":"The repair work rediscovered: exact 2-decimal regex, EXCLUDING as exclusion keyword, upscale-before-OCR, multi-OCR variants, tier-aware extraction. These remain in task-local script, not reflected as reusable guidance in image-ocr.md."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Current image-ocr.md keyword rules do not include EXCLUDING-style pre-tax subtotal markers, do not require exactly 2 decimal digits for monetary numbers, and do not describe cross-OCR consensus or Subtotal/Payment cross-validation. Multi-pass OCR section advises concatenation, which duplicates candidates and corrupts last-match tier logic. No guidance on tier-aware extraction returning (tier, value) for later arbitration."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Two-line fallback is described loosely ('last number on next line') but does not specify: scan up to N (e.g., 3) subsequent non-empty lines, stop at exclusion keywords, and prefer the first line that yields a 2-decimal number."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Preprocessing section does not recommend conditional 2× upscaling for small/low-DPI receipts, which measurably helped (071 date, 074 total). It also lacks a 'try default OCR AND preprocessed OCR, then arbitrate' pattern."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction section lacks disambiguation guidance: prefer parses where month ≤ 12 is forced (DD/MM/YYYY for Malaysian receipts), reject impossible months instead of swapping, and cross-check across OCR variants."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Does not call out that OCR pipelines must write monetary fields as 2-decimal strings (object dtype) and nulls as empty cells, not NaN or 'None' strings — a recurring failure mode for scoring."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Receipt total extraction' subsection codifying: (a) exclusion keywords including SUBTOTAL/SUB TOTAL/TAX/GST/SST/DISCOUNT/CHANGE/CASH TENDERED/EXCLUDING; (b) priority tiers GRAND TOTAL > TOTAL RM/TOTAL: RM > TOTAL AMOUNT > {TOTAL, AMOUNT, NET TOTAL, NETT TOTAL, TOTAL DUE, AMOUNT DUE, BALANCE DUE}; (c) within a tier, return (tier_index, value, line_quality) and arbitrate across OCR variants rather than blind last-match."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Specify the number regex must require EXACTLY two decimal digits for monetary totals (`\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2}` with word-boundary guards), strip RM/$ prefixes and thousands commas, and never silently promote 1-decimal matches to .X0."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Replace the 'concatenate multi-pass outputs' pattern with 'run multiple OCR variants independently, extract candidates per variant, then arbitrate by: (1) highest-priority tier, (2) cross-variant agreement, (3) agreement with Subtotal/Payment values, (4) prefer line without heavy OCR noise'. Provide pseudocode."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand the two-line fallback: scan up to 3 following non-empty lines, stop on exclusion keyword or new section header; accept the first 2-decimal number found."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add preprocessing guidance: if min(width,height) < ~1200px, upscale 2× with LANCZOS before OCR; combine with grayscale+autocontrast; try PSM 6 primary, PSM 4 and default PSM 3 as alternates."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Strengthen date extraction: prefer DD/MM/YYYY when month>12 would otherwise result; reject parses with month>12 or day>31 instead of swapping; when multiple OCR variants disagree, prefer the one that yields a plausible (year in reasonable range AND month≤12) date; return None rather than guessing when all variants are implausible."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add explicit output contract notes for tabular writers: date as 'YYYY-MM-DD' string or None; amount as string with exactly two decimals (f'{v:.2f}') or None; never float, never 'nan'/'None' text."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a short 'OCR-to-Excel null & string-format contract' note: use object dtype for monetary columns, write Python None (empty cell), preserve 2-decimal string formatting, sort rows by filename lexicographically, single sheet 'results', only 3 columns."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Document common pitfalls observed: digit confusions (1↔7, 0↔6, 5↔S), decimal-point loss on faded prints ('10.00'→'1000'), and 'Total Amt Rounded' lines being noisier than 'Total incl. of GST' — recommend preferring the clean-match within same tier when ambiguous."}],"confidence":0.72}
